author: Phobiaxx
body:
A kitpvp gamemode. The objective of the game is to capture all the points
Hue, this is probably one of the longest and boring game suggestions ever... It might take FOREVER to code ;c but ive played it before... well... sort of, I made a ton of tweaks ;p
Gameplay: There can be either 2 or 4 teams. Enemy players CANNOT enter the spawns. Each team has a spawn structure.
For 2 teams:
Each Team has 1 spawn, and 3 small "forts" or a basic wall, with 4 towers, and a center capturing point. There is 1 GIANT fort in the middle, with a claiming spot at the top. There are 'gates' which can be destroyed only with TNT. Each fort has 4 cannons, and 1 cannon outside, facing the gates, which a player can shoot tnt out of. (not a tnt cannon, but a plugin cannon) Players can just right click the gate to go inside(only if they own the fort) Also, to break the gates, players can hack at the bars, after 3 seconds, one block will break.
For 4 teams:
Each team has 1 spawn, and 1 fort. there is a center GIANT fort. Everything else is the same as 2 teams.
Claiming and Fixing:
To claim a base, an enemy has to sneak in and kill everyone, and start claiming, in the center. Each base has 23 points, at first... it is 23/23, it will lose 1 point every 5 seconds a player is standing there. The more enemies there are in the claiming area... the faster it will claim. If there are 2 players, it will claim 2 every 5 seconds, for 3, 3 every 5 seconds.
Fixing:
To fix a base, just go to your base and do the same as claiming, except, its 1 point every 4 seconds. The same multi claiming feature as claiming. The gates will heal themselves if you are fixing the base.
(While claiming or fixing, the player has resistance 1 and regeneration 1.)
A team can claim back their base.
The winner is whoever owns all bases.

XP+token rewarding:
+5XP-->Your Team captured a point! 0.05 tokens
+20XP-->You have captured a point!0.2 tokens.
+2XP-->you killed someone!0.01 tokens.
+30XP-->Captured 3 points in one game!(bonus)0.3 tokens.
+6XP-->DOUBLE KILL!(killed 2 people 1 second after the other)0.1 tokens
+15XP--->TRIPLE KILL!(killed 3 people 1 second after the other)0.4
+20XP--->Winning the Game!2 tokens.
+10XP--->2nd place! 1 tokens. (only applies for matches with 4 teams)
+5XP-->Good game! (you played in the match.)0 tokens.
+25XP-->You have captured 10 points!(1 token)
+50XP-->you have captured 5 points in 1 game!(3 tokens)
+250XP--->you have captured 15 points in 1 game!
+250XP--->you have won 50 games!(5 tokens)
+300XP---->You have captured 200 points!(5 tokens)
+20XP--->Unlocked your 1st Special Kit!(1 token)
+500XP--->Unlocked all Special Kits(5 tokens)
+500XP---->You have captured 400 points!(5 tokens)
+1500XP--->You have captured 3000 points!(30 tokens)
For every prestige:+30 tokens
For prestige 5:+100 tokens
Voting:instead of 30xp... 1 token.
Kits:
Main loadout: 3 Gapples, Shop, Champion Selector.

Lvl1-->Squire--->full leather armor, with diamond boots(prot 1), iron sword.
Lvl5--->Archer--->full leather armor, infinity bow, 1 arrow
Lvl10--->Barbarian--->Speed 1, full leather armor, iron sword
lvl15-->Knight---->Full iron armor(except helmet, leather) iron sword, mining fatigue 1
lvl20--->Marksman--->full leather armor, power 1 bow, 64 arrows, each kill grants 32.
lvl25--->Assassin--->Full leather armor, diamond sword with sharpness 5(the assassin can only hit with it once, and then the sword will dissapear, and come back in 20 seconds.
lvl30--->Mage--->Full leather armor, wooden sword, blaze rod, stick, and empty bottle.
Blaze rod: shoots a fireball, 4HP damage. regenerates every 5 seconds. Stick:slows the player it is pointed at, when left clicked, gives poison I for 2 seconds, and blindness for 3 seconds. Regenerates every 50 seconds. Empty Bottle:Heals the mage 8 HP(4 hearts), when right clicked, regenerates every 30 seconds.
lvl40--->Ninja--->full leather armor, iron sword, has speed II, and Haste I. Has a feather, when left clicked, gives ninja invisibility for 8 seconds. Regenerates every 30 seconds.
lvl45--->Necromancer-->full leather armor. wooden sword(unbreaking 3) ability: for every heart of damage it deals... it gains 1/2 of that damage in HP.

 
<Special Kits>
lvl20-->Ninja Lord--->full leather armor, diamond sword. Has speed 2, haste 1. Has a feather, when left clicked, gives ninja invisibility for 12 seconds. Regenerates every 32 seconds. No fall damage. Also has a sugar, when left clicked, gives him speed 10 for 2 seconds. Regenerates once every 2 minutes.[Need 80 tokens to unlock. 8 tokens every 4 days.]
lvl25--->Fire Lord--->full leather armor, no sword. Has a fireball, blaze powder, blaze rod, and redstone. Fireball:shoots a basic fireball at an enemy, does 6HP damage, player will catch on fire for 2 seconds, when right clicked. Regenerates every 4 seconds. blaze powder: shoots a nova of flame particles for 2 seconds. If a player is within 8 blocks, they will get 5HP damage, every 1/3 second they stay within the nova. Regenerates every 2 minutes. Blaze Rod: Summons lightning at smites the nearest enemy player when right clicked, deals 20HP damage. Regenerates once every minute. [100 tokens to unlock, 10 tokens every 4 days.]

lvl25-->Time Lord-->has a stone sword full leather armor, clock, and 5 snowballs. Snowballs:when a snowball hits a player, it freezes them for 4 seconds. For every kill the time lord gains, he is granted 2 snowballs. Clock: shoots out a nova of enchantment particles. Up to 3 players who are within 6 blocks will be frozen for 5 seconds, dealing 6HP damage every second. If the timelord gets hurt, the spell ends immediately. Regenerates every 2 minutes. [75 tokens to unlock, 7 tokens every 4 days.]

lvl25-->Berserker--> has an empty potion, feather, full leather armor, and a stone sword. empty potion grants any teammate within a 14 block radius speed 3 and haste 4 for 20 seconds. Regenerates every 8 minutes. Feather: upon right clicking, player gains speed 2 and haste 2 for 4 seconds. Regenerates every 30 seconds.[74 tokens to unlock, 6 tokens every 4 days.]

lvl38--->Dark Essence--->has full leather black armor(with -prot enchantments to render armor to 0. Ability:Mass Destruction, shoots a beam of dark particles 5-10 blocks forward(with a sound). Instantly kills all enemies it hits. Player has to stand completely still for 6 seconds, in order for an eye of ender to appear, which upon left clicking allows him to use his ability. [83 tokens to unlock, 8tokens every 4 days.]
lvl30-->Count Technor--->full gold armor(blast protection 200) 10TNT.(is granted 4 TNT for every kill, tnt explodes once placed, can only harm players and gates)  Abilites: has another TNT, flint and steel, iron ingot, and redstone. TNT:when left clicked, 4 TNT is spewed out, does 15HP damage each, spewed out 7 blocks. Regenerates every 40 seconds. Flint and Steel:Sets all  enemy players within a 10 block radius on fire for 5 seconds. Regenerates every minute. Iron ingot:"bombs the area" causes explosion particles in a 15 block radius, every enemy in range will receive 25HP damage. Regenerates every 4 minutes. Redstone: New technology enables Technor to sabotage enemy biotics. All enemies within a 10 block radius receive Blindness, Mining Fatigue II, Slowness III, weakness II for 5 seconds. Regenerates every 8 minutes.[85 tokens to unlock, 8 tokens every 4 days.]

Shop:
Potion of Healing-5 points
Potion of Healing II-8 points
4 Golden Apples-10 points
8 golden apples-15 points
64 arrows-15 points
5 TNT-10 points
TNT-3 points
Gold Shop(gold ingot)-0 points
(opens up  another menu:)
All special kits and their prices.
Amulet of Claiming(20 tokens)(red dye)
Amulet of Chardisser(50 tokens)(+50% XP boost)(wooden sword)
Amulet of Medrovor(100 tokens) (+100%XP boost.)(iron sword)
Amulet of Merrovorn(200 tokens)(+150%XP boost.)(diamond sword)

Special kits have a subscription, every 4 days it takes some of your tokens, if you do not have enough, you cannot use it. There is an option to deactive a kit in the menu.
